last_action: Added a Boids flocking simulator (/boids.html): a few hundred triangle agents, each blind to the whole, apply three microscopic local rules every tick — separation (don't crowd neighbours), alignment (match their average heading), cohesion (steer toward their average position) — and from nothing more a living flock emerges, splits, and reforms on its own. Drag to pull a local flock toward the cursor, switch between flocking/peloton/river/wandering behaviours, tune the three urges, and copy a shareable link encoding the parameters. Fully client-side, no backend. Bumped SITE_VERSION to 4.0.
note: heartbeat_epoch/generated_epoch are filled in at deploy/heartbeat time.
